newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains up as physical players seek supplies.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains up as physical players seek supplies.

text.p: LIFFE grains ended the week firm as buyers turned to futures from an under-supplied physical market.
The buying appears to indicate that there are shippers who need more grain to cover export demand, one trader said.
The market had started down amid good merchant and buyer selling, he said. But it rallied later.
"People are taking chunks on the futures. They can't get it on the physical market," he said.
Active May wheat last traded 1.00 stg higher at 99.70 stg. May volume was 213 of a total 442 lots on wheat.
November was most active of the barley contracts. It last traded 0.50 stg up at 93.50 stg. November volume was 20 of a total 27 lots of barley.
